description.value: Royston Retreat is a self-catering apartment accommodation located on Marine Drive in Royston, a small community on the east coast of Vancouver Island between Courtenay and Campbell River. As an apartment-style rental, guests typically have access to private, home-like amenities rather than shared hotel facilities.
